skill.name: brand-guidelines
skill.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
skill.summary: Applies Anthropic brand colors, typography, and styling guidance to visual artifacts.
skill.author: DYAI2025

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent visual styling when creating branded artifacts. This skill provides Anthropic colors, typography, and usage guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Provides Anthropic main colors and accent colors for visual artifacts.
Specifies Poppins for headings and Lora for body text.
Defines fallback fonts for environments without Poppins or Lora.
Guides smart text color choices based on background contrast.
Describes accent color use for non-text shapes and presentation elements.
limitations: Does not install fonts or verify local font availability.
Does not include executable tooling for automatic file conversion.
Applies only to Anthropic brand styling, not other brand systems.
Final visual quality depends on the target document or design tool.

use_cases.title: Style Executive Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply Anthropic colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and accent colors to a slide deck.

use_cases.title: Format Internal Documents
use_cases.description: Use consistent typography and color guidance for briefs, reports, and planning documents.

use_cases.title: Review Brand Consistency
use_cases.description: Check whether visual elements follow the stated palette, typography, and contrast guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Styling
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple document or slide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to apply Anthropic brand colors and typography to my artifact. Keep the layout readable and preserve the content hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh A Presentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a slide deck update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this presentation with Anthropic main colors, accent colors, Poppins headings, and Lora body text. Keep charts and tables clear.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Brand Fit
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for review before publishing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this artifact for Anthropic brand consistency. Identify color, typography, contrast, and hierarchy changes needed before publication.

prompt_templates.title: Create Detailed Styling Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a multi-format campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed styling plan for slides, documents, and visuals using this skill. Include typography, palette use, accent rules, and review checks.

output_examples.input: Restyle a product update deck with Anthropic branding.
output_examples.output: The deck uses dark text on light backgrounds, Poppins-style headings, Lora-style body text, and restrained orange accents.

output_examples.input: Review a one-page report for brand consistency.
output: Headings should use the heading font guidance.
Body sections should use the body font guidance.
Accent colors should be limited to emphasis and supporting shapes.

output_examples.input: Prepare guidance for a branded workshop handout.
output_examples.output: Use the light background, dark primary text, clear heading hierarchy, and limited accent colors for callouts.

best_practices: Use accent colors sparingly so the primary content remains clear.
Check contrast after applying brand colors to text and backgrounds.
Install Poppins and Lora before high-fidelity export when possible.
anti_patterns: Do not apply all accent colors to every page or slide.
Do not reduce text contrast for decorative brand matching.
Do not replace the specified typography with unrelated display fonts.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps style presentations, documents, and visual artifacts with Anthropic brand colors and typography.

faq.question: Does it install fonts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Poppins and Lora, with Arial and Georgia as fallbacks.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides written brand guidance and does not include automation scripts.

faq.question: Can it style non-presentation documents?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance can apply to any artifact that benefits from consistent visual styling.

faq.question: Is it limited to Anthropic branding?
faq.answer: Yes. The palette and typography guidance are specific to Anthropic style.
